knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=A NanoStringGeoMxSet object containing normalized and raw expression data ;; norm=A matrix of normalized expression data ;; raw=A matrix of raw expression data, used to derive weights to down-weight low-count observations ;; bg=A matrix of expected background counts for all data points in the normalized data matrix ;; X=A cell profile matrix specifying expected expression profiles of each cell type ;; align_genes=Logical, whether to align genes between expression data and the cell profile matrix ;; cellmerges=A list object specifying how to sum closely-related cell types into a single score ;; cell_counts=A vector of nuclei counts for each observation, used to scale results to total cell counts ;; is_pure_tumor=A logical vector identifying pure tumor segments to infer tumor-specific profiles ;; n_tumor_clusters=Number of distinct tumor profiles to append to the cell profile matrix ;; minCellNum=Minimum number of cells of one type needed to create a custom profile ;; minGenes=Minimum number of genes expressed in a cell to keep it during custom profile creation
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: When analyzing spatial (e.g., NanoString GeoMx) or bulk gene expression data to estimate the abundance of mixed cell types (such as immune and stroma cells in the tumor microenvironment) using pre-defined or custom cell profile matrices.
- pitfalls: Low counts are statistically unstable; raw data should be provided to down-weight them. In studies with multiple probesets, genes from each probeset have distinct background values and background estimation must account for this (e.g., using derive_GeoMx_background or running separately per probeset). When two cell types are too similar, their individual abundance estimates become unstable (use collapseCellTypes or cellmerges to sum them). Low cell counts for a cell type in single-cell data will cause them to be dropped during custom profile matrix creation (adjust minCellNum or minGenes if they are necessary).

workflows.name: geomx_set_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform spatial deconvolution, cell type collapsing, tumor profile merging, and reverse deconvolution using a NanoStringGeoMxSet object.
input: nsclc (NanoStringGeoMxSet object containing normalized and raw expression data, feature data, and phenotypic data)
workflows.stages: 1. Update and prepare the GeoMxSet object ;; 2. Estimate background using derive_GeoMx_background ;; 3. Run basic deconvolution using runspatialdecon ;; 4. Run advanced deconvolution with tumor modeling, cell merging, and cell count estimation using runspatialdecon ;; 5. Plot results using TIL_barplot and florets ;; 6. Collapse closely-related cell types using runCollapseCellTypes ;; 7. Merge tumor profiles into the cell profile matrix using runMergeTumorIntoX ;; 8. Perform reverse deconvolution using runReverseDecon
workflows.code:
library(SpatialDecon)
library(GeomxTools)
data("nsclc")
nsclc <- updateGeoMxSet(nsclc)
sampleNames(nsclc) <- paste0(nsclc$ROI, nsclc$AOI.name)
featureType(nsclc) <- "Target"
bg = derive_GeoMx_background(norm = nsclc@assayData$exprs_norm,
                             probepool = fData(nsclc)$Module,
                             negnames = c("NegProbe-CTP01", "NegProbe-Kilo"))
data("safeTME")
data("safeTME.matches")
res = runspatialdecon(object = nsclc,
                      norm_elt = "exprs_norm",
                      raw_elt = "exprs",
                      X = safeTME,
                      align_genes = TRUE)
nsclc$istumor = nsclc$AOI.name == "Tumor"
restils = runspatialdecon(object = nsclc,
                          norm_elt = "exprs_norm",
                          raw_elt = "exprs",
                          X = safeTME,
                          cellmerges = safeTME.matches,
                          cell_counts = nsclc$nuclei,
                          is_pure_tumor = nsclc$istumor,
                          n_tumor_clusters = 5)
data("cellcols")
o = hclust(dist(t(restils$cell.counts$cell.counts)))$order
layout(mat = (matrix(c(1, 2), 1)), widths = c(7, 3))
TIL_barplot(t(restils$cell.counts$cell.counts[, o]), draw_legend = TRUE, 
            cex.names = 0.5)
temp = replace(restils$prop_of_nontumor, is.na(restils$prop_of_nontumor), 0)
o = hclust(dist(temp[restils$AOI.name == "TME",]))$order
TIL_barplot(t(restils$prop_of_nontumor[restils$AOI.name == "TME",])[, o], 
            draw_legend = TRUE, cex.names = 0.75)
pc = prcomp(t(log2(pmax(nsclc@assayData$exprs_norm, 1))))$x[, c(1, 2)]
par(mar = c(5,5,1,1))
layout(mat = (matrix(c(1, 2), 1)), widths = c(6, 2))
florets(x = pc[, 1], y = pc[, 2],
        b = t(restils$beta), cex = .5,
        xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
frame()
legend("center", fill = cellcols[colnames(restils$beta)], 
       legend = colnames(restils$beta), cex = 0.7)
matching = list()
matching$myeloid = c( "macrophages", "monocytes", "mDCs")
matching$T.NK = c("CD4.T.cells","CD8.T.cells", "Treg", "NK")
matching$B = c("B")
matching$mast = c("mast")
matching$neutrophils = c("neutrophils")
matching$stroma = c("endothelial.cells", "fibroblasts")
collapsed = runCollapseCellTypes(object = restils, 
                                 matching = matching)
pure.tumor.ids = res$AOI.name == "Tumor"
safeTME.with.tumor = runMergeTumorIntoX(object = nsclc,
                                        norm_elt = "exprs_norm", 
                                        pure_tumor_ids = pure.tumor.ids,
                                        X = safeTME,
                                        K = 3)
rdecon = runReverseDecon(object = nsclc,
                         norm_elt = "exprs_norm",
                         beta = res$beta)

workflows.name: standard_matrix_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform spatial deconvolution, cell type collapsing, tumor profile merging, and reverse deconvolution using standard R matrices.
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare segment names and align annotations ;; 2. Estimate background matrix manually or using derive_GeoMx_background ;; 3. Run basic deconvolution using spatialdecon ;; 4. Run advanced deconvolution with tumor modeling, cell merging, and cell count estimation using spatialdecon ;; 5. Plot results using TIL_barplot and florets ;; 6. Collapse closely-related cell types using collapseCellTypes ;; 7. Merge tumor profiles into the cell profile matrix using mergeTumorIntoX ;; 8. Perform reverse deconvolution using reverseDecon
workflows.code:
library(SpatialDecon)
data("mini_geomx_dataset")
norm = mini_geomx_dataset$normalized
raw = mini_geomx_dataset$raw
annot = mini_geomx_dataset$annot
colnames(norm) = colnames(raw) = rownames(annot) = 
  paste0(annot$ROI, annot$AOI.name)
per.observation.mean.neg = norm["NegProbe", ]
bg = sweep(norm * 0, 2, per.observation.mean.neg, "+")
bg2 = derive_GeoMx_background(norm = norm,
                             probepool = rep(1, nrow(norm)),
                             negnames = "NegProbe")
data("safeTME")
data("safeTME.matches")
res = spatialdecon(norm = norm,
                   bg = bg,
                   X = safeTME,
                   align_genes = TRUE)
annot$istumor = (annot$AOI.name == "Tumor")
restils = spatialdecon(norm = norm,
                       raw = raw,
                       bg = bg,
                       X = safeTME,
                       cellmerges = safeTME.matches,
                       cell_counts = annot$nuclei,
                       is_pure_tumor = annot$istumor,
                       n_tumor_clusters = 5)
data("cellcols")
layout(mat = (matrix(c(1, 2), 1)), widths = c(7, 3))
TIL_barplot(restils$cell.counts$cell.counts, draw_legend = TRUE, 
            cex.names = 0.5)
TIL_barplot(restils$prop_of_nontumor[, annot$AOI.name == "TME"], 
            draw_legend = TRUE, cex.names = 0.75)
pc = prcomp(t(log2(pmax(norm, 1))))$x[, c(1, 2)]
par(mar = c(5,5,1,1))
layout(mat = (matrix(c(1, 2), 1)), widths = c(6, 2))
florets(x = pc[, 1], y = pc[, 2],
        b = restils$beta, cex = 2,
        xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
frame()
legend("center", fill = cellcols[rownames(restils$beta)], 
       legend = rownames(restils$beta), cex = 0.7)
matching = list()
matching$myeloid = c( "macrophages", "monocytes", "mDCs")
matching$T.NK = c("CD4.T.cells","CD8.T.cells", "Treg", "NK")
matching$B = c("B")
matching$mast = c("mast")
matching$neutrophils = c("neutrophils")
matching$stroma = c("endothelial.cells", "fibroblasts")
collapsed = collapseCellTypes(fit = restils, 
                              matching = matching)
pure.tumor.ids = annot$AOI.name == "Tumor"
safeTME.with.tumor = mergeTumorIntoX(norm = norm, 
                                     bg = bg, 
                                     pure_tumor_ids = pure.tumor.ids, 
                                     X = safeTME, 
                                     K = 3)
rdecon = reverseDecon(norm = norm,
                      beta = res$beta)

workflows.name: custom_profile_matrix_generation
workflows.intent: Create a custom cell profile matrix from single-cell RNA-seq count matrices or Seurat objects.
input: mini_singleCell_dataset$mtx (sparse matrix of single-cell gene expression counts)
mini_singleCell_dataset$annots (data frame of cell annotations containing cell type and cell name columns)
seuratObject (Seurat object containing single-cell counts and metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Load single-cell dataset or create a Seurat object ;; 2. Generate custom profile matrix from raw counts and annotations using create_profile_matrix ;; 3. Alternatively, extract counts and annotations from a Seurat object and generate the profile matrix using create_profile_matrix
workflows.code:
library(SpatialDecon)
data("mini_singleCell_dataset")
custom_mtx <- create_profile_matrix(mtx = mini_singleCell_dataset$mtx,
                                    cellAnnots = mini_singleCell_dataset$annots,
                                    cellTypeCol = "LabeledCellType",
                                    cellNameCol = "CellID",
                                    matrixName = "custom_mini_colon",
                                    outDir = NULL,
                                    normalize = FALSE,
                                    minCellNum = 5,
                                    minGenes = 10,
                                    scalingFactor = 5,
                                    discardCellTypes = TRUE)
library(SeuratObject)
library(Seurat)
data("mini_singleCell_dataset")
rownames(mini_singleCell_dataset$annots) <- mini_singleCell_dataset$annots$CellID
seuratObject <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mini_singleCell_dataset$mtx, 
                                   meta.data = mini_singleCell_dataset$annots)
Idents(seuratObject) <- seuratObject$LabeledCellType
rm(mini_singleCell_dataset)
annots <- data.frame(cbind(cellType=as.character(Idents(seuratObject)), 
                           cellID=names(Idents(seuratObject))))
custom_mtx_seurat <- create_profile_matrix(mtx = Seurat::GetAssayData(object = seuratObject, 
                                                                      assay = "RNA", 
                                                                      layer = "counts"), 
                                           cellAnnots = annots, 
                                           cellTypeCol = "cellType", 
                                           cellNameCol = "cellID", 
                                           matrixName = "custom_mini_colon",
                                           outDir = NULL, 
                                           normalize = FALSE, 
                                           minCellNum = 5, 
                                           minGenes = 10)
